title: Titan's Hidden Ocean
description: Under a hundred kilometres of ice, Titan hides an ocean of salty water, larger than all of Earth's. Unlocks the Cryobot that melts down into it, and the ecosystem round its vents.

puzzle.goal: Under a layer of ice of density r and thickness h, on a world whose surface gravity is g, write the load P the ice puts on each square metre of the ocean below.
puzzle.name: Stevin's law
puzzle.ask: Find P in pascals under Titan's ice: r = @{r} kg/m³, g = @{g} m/s², h = 100000 m.
puzzle.method: Each square metre carries the weight of the column above it: its mass, r·h, times g.
